audit.why: 49.57% over 351 games; EVEN / 6-10 holds. Fiora owns levels 1-3 in melee range, Singed proxies and out-kites later. Matches the mirror's finding.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Fiora and 2+ items was given to Fiora, contradicting the packet chart, the page's own late/spikes[3] text, and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror recorded 'Level 6 -> Skill (both ults land at 6), 2+ items -> Singed', and late says outright 'Late game flips to Singed'. The chart must not contradict the mirror.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Skill, 2+ items -> Singed, with phases[4].why and phases[6].why rewritten to carry the reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds against Fiora's healing, and Mega Adhesive's grounding against Lunge.
audit.why: Riot text: Insanity Potion makes 'his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds'. Both of Fiora's heals — Duelist's Dance on Vital hits and Grand Challenge's heal field — are cut once she is standing in poison, which is the whole reason her level-6 all-in stops being free. Mega Adhesive 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it', and grounding disables dashes, so Lunge is dead while she is in the glue; the Fling into the goo also roots.
audit.corrected: Insanity Potion makes his poison apply Grievous Wounds, halving your Vital and R heals; Mega Adhesive grounds, so Lunge is dead while you stand in it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling is the tracked cooldown but no duration is given.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and Mega Adhesive 17/16/15/14/13s — the glue is the longer, more punishable one.
audit.corrected: Fling, 10s at rank 1. Riposte it — the knock-up returns a stun.

edits.before: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins any committed duel. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Singed's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both ults land at 6: yours marks four Vitals, but Insanity Potion makes his poison apply Grievous Wounds and halves every heal you get back.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Singed carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, Singed perma-kites: Rylai's plus his drafting speed means you never hold Vital range. Split, and stop chasing him.

edits.before: At 6 your R marks all four Vitals and Riposte can parry his Fling knock-up into a stun, but a missed W means he Flings you off and the all-in becomes a coinflip — skill decides it.
edits.after: At 6 Riposte still parries his Fling knock-up into a stun, but Insanity Potion makes his poison apply Grievous Wounds, so the Vital and R heals you bank on are cut in half.

edits.before: Fling you into his poison trail when Riposte is down, then stroll off on W move speed instead of standing to duel
edits.after: Glue you first — Mega Adhesive grounds, so Lunge is dead — then Fling you into the trail once Riposte is spent

edits.before: His flip. Riposte it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling, 10s at rank 1. Riposte it — the knock-up returns a stun.

notes: Chart flipped as one group to agree with the already-audited Singed side. The two additions are the ones the mirror flagged as absent: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds against Fiora's two heal sources, and Mega Adhesive's grounding shutting off Lunge. The mirror also noted that Lunge applies on-hit effects so Fiora scales with attack speed, not only AD — still unwritten here for lack of length budget.
